meta.title: Nemu.in — Find Clients, Not Excuses
meta.description: Sweep Google Maps for local businesses with no website, score them with AI, and walk away with a WhatsApp opener that actually gets a reply.

hero.title: Within 5 km of where you're sitting, hundreds of businesses still have no website.
hero.subtitle: Nemu.in sweeps Google Maps, keeps only the ones with a live WhatsApp number and an empty website field, then writes an opener that names their shop — not a copy-paste template.
hero.trust: No card. No subscription. No risk to your WhatsApp account.

how.title: Three steps. Done before your coffee goes cold.
how.step1Title: Name a city and a trade
how.step1Body: "Coffee shops in Yogyakarta". Nemu.in sweeps Google Maps and keeps only the ones with a working phone number.
how.step2Title: Let the AI do the judging
how.step2Body: Each business gets a 1–100 score based on rating, review volume, and how much revenue they're leaving on the table without a site.
how.step3Body: One tap opens WhatsApp with the message pre-filled. You reread it, then hit send yourself.

ghost.title: Show them. Don't explain it.
ghost.body: Nemu.in instantly assembles a sample website for your prospect using their real name, category and rating. Screenshot it, send it on WhatsApp, and let the picture do the selling.
ghost.hint: Free. Zero credits. Zero AI calls.
ghost.mockTagline: Open daily · Order straight through WhatsApp
ghost.mockPoint1: Trusted by {count} customers who left a review
ghost.mockPoint2: Rated {rating} out of 5 on Google Maps

auth.title: Quick sign-in, so your credits stick to your account
auth.body: A Google account is all it takes. No password, no contact access.
auth.failed: The sign-in dropped halfway. Give it one more go.
auth.signInBody: Enter your email and password, and you're in.
auth.signUpBody: Free. You start with 30 credits the moment it's made.
auth.toSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in

err.badCredentials: That email and password don't match. Check them again.
err.weakPassword: Password is too short — 8 characters minimum.
err.emailTaken: That email is already registered. Try signing in.
err.rateLimited: Too many accounts created from this connection today. Try tomorrow.
err.unknown: Something jammed. Give it one more go.

hunt.title: Where are we hunting?
hunt.subtitle: The more specific you are, the better this gets.
hunt.queryPlaceholder: coffee shop, motorbike repair, dental clinic…
hunt.scanningSub: Filtering for live numbers and empty website fields…
hunt.emptyBody: Your keyword might be too narrow, or the area simply isn't densely listed on Google Maps yet.
hunt.expandBody: We can re-run the sweep with a longer reach. It's free — failed searches never cost credits.
hunt.cachedNote: {count} leads came from your archive — free, no quota used.
hunt.locationDenied: Location denied. No problem — just type the city name.
hunt.landedBody: Open the Archive tab to start reaching out, or the Map tab to see how they cluster.

lead.noPhoneHint: No number listed. Check the location on Maps, or look up their Instagram.

pitch.title: Opener for {name}
pitch.disclaimer: Reread before sending. You press send, not us — so your number stays safe.
pitch.deepBody: The AI will dissect this business's specific weak points and build a sharper sales argument.

credits.label: Credits
credits.emptyBody: Search and AI features are resting until your balance is topped up.

god.title: God Mode
god.subtitle: Everything moving inside Nemu.in, visible from one screen.
god.injected: {amount} credits landed on {name}. Their screen updated instantly.
god.killSwitchHint: Flip this off when the Google quota gets tight. It hits every user immediately.

errors.genericBody: Not your fault. Try again — if it's still stubborn, give it a minute and come back.
errors.notFoundBody: The address might have a typo, or we've moved the page.
errors.insufficientTitle: Not enough credits for this step.
errors.apiDownBody: An admin paused API calls to protect the quota. Try again later.
errors.quotaTitle: Google's daily quota is maxed out.
errors.quotaBody: That limit is theirs, not ours. It resets at midnight Pacific time.
errors.aiBusyBody: We tried both routes and both are full. Your credits were not deducted.
errors.notConfiguredTitle: The AI key isn't set on the server.
errors.notConfiguredBody: This needs GEMINI_API_KEY in the Vercel environment variables. Your credits were refunded.

map.emptyBody: Sweep an area from the Hunt tab and every result shows up here as a pin.
map.unavailableBody: The map token isn't configured on the server. Check NEXT_PUBLIC_MAPBOX_TOKEN.

leads.emptyBody: Open the Hunt tab, name a trade and a city. Results land here automatically.
